WIRING ASYMMETRY — only Tactic is wired end-to-end.
Tactic: domain entity + TacticRepository + DSO + TacticReadService (application) + TacticController (api).
Directive / Styleguide / Paradigm: domain entity + identifier VO + repository port + DSO ONLY.
They have NO application read service and NO REST controller yet — all three dangle at the storage edge.
Closing that gap is the next wiring step.
